execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
  m.chembl_id,
  r.compound_name,
  s.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records r ON d.doc_id = r.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary m ON r.molregno = m.molregno
JOIN compound_structures s ON m.molregno = s.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3886467'
ORDER BY m.chembl_id, r.compound_name, s.canonical_smiles;
```
